_comment: GraphRAG 1.5 gold set for judge-independent retrieval evaluation. Per domain: query -> expected_entities (canonical concepts a good retrieval should surface). Both expected and retrieved entities are passed through normalize_entity before matching, so this stays valid across the alias re-index. SEED SET (~3/domain) - expand toward 20-30/domain per Bani's spec; refine expected_entities against harness output.
